title: Super Supportive · Episode 24 · 猫粮呢？
description: Victor comes home hungry. Alden welcomes the company, but a missing dinner and a silent phone test his patience.

sources.title: Super Supportive — Sleyca, Chapter 8

planning.continuingQuestion: Why is Connie not answering, and how will Alden face the rest of his evening?

opening.moment: Alden promises Victor dinner before discovering missing food
opening.speaker: Alden

continuation.end: Victor arrives and Alden welcomes the distraction. Cat food is missing despite a search of cupboards, drawers, fridge and trash. He suspects Connie or the unknown owner of the tiger shorts without evidence. Two messages receive no reply; he gives Victor a small piece of bologna. After showering he dries his hair and tries not to judge Connie. No phone call or funeral decision.
continuation.nextStart: No way am I going to sleep anytime soon.
continuation.note: Alden calls Clytem Zhao, reaches voicemail and accepts the funeral invitation. He then prepares to go out and invites Victor to get tuna and meet Gorgon. Stop before the author note and next chapter.
